import sys


def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    n = data[0]
    values = data[1:]
    del data

    order = sorted(range(n), key=values.__getitem__)
    count_tree = [0] * (n + 1)
    sum_tree = [0] * (n + 1)

    mod = 1_000_000_007
    boundary = n + 1
    total_positions = 0
    answer = 0

    for processed, index in enumerate(order):
        position = index + 1
        left_count = 0
        left_sum = 0
        node = position - 1

        while node:
            left_count += count_tree[node]
            left_sum += sum_tree[node]
            node -= node & -node

        right_weight = (
            boundary * (processed - left_count)
            - total_positions
            + left_sum
        )
        coefficient = (
            (boundary - position) * (position + left_sum)
            + position * right_weight
        )
        answer = (answer + values[index] * coefficient) % mod

        node = position
        while node <= n:
            count_tree[node] += 1
            sum_tree[node] += position
            node += node & -node

        total_positions += position

    print(answer)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
